name: state-delta-unappliable-warns-and-keeps
description: a well-formed patch whose path does not resolve warns, applies nothing at all, and does not fail the run
kill: let the STATE_DELTA patch failure propagate instead of warning and keeping the prior state, or make it keep the partially applied document

dotnet.intentional: the .NET client says nothing here, and cannot assert the state clause at all: it has no state store and no JSON Patch reducer, so STATE_* events reach a consumer only as raw pass-through and nothing ever attempts the patch that would fail. What this lane still holds .NET to is that the run stays alive and quiet. `warnings` is emptied only to displace the base expectation; `noWarnings` asserts the silence. Aligning .NET is tracked separately.
